program_source:
def task():
    acquire("left", "tool_beta")
    wait("left", 40000000)
    release("left", "tool_beta")
    acquire("right", "tool_beta")
    wait("right", 40000000)
    release("right", "tool_beta")
brief_author_note: The program performs two sequential timed tool-use turns, first with the left arm and then with the right arm, and releases the shared tool at the end.
